mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (communityId, userId, content) VALUES (#{boardIdx}, #{writer}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.commentId as commentIdx, c.communityId as boardIdx, u.name as writer, c.content, c.createdAt as indate, u.profileImg as profileImg, u.trackId as trackId, t.trackName as trackName FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.userId = u.userId LEFT JOIN tracks t ON u.trackId = t.trackId WHERE c.communityId = #{boardIdx} ORDER BY c.commentId ASC

SELECT c.commentId as commentIdx, c.communityId as boardIdx, u.name as writer, c.content, c.createdAt as indate, u.profileImg as profileImg, u.trackId as trackId, t.trackName as trackName FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.userId = u.userId LEFT JOIN tracks t ON u.trackId = t.trackId WHERE c.commentId = #{commentIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET content = #{content} WHERE commentId = #{commentIdx}
